answer: Auditors fly as falcons, every bird with a falconer whose bond is on the line: each dive is attributable to a named bird on a public perch, flight log open. A bird is ranked by verified accuracy, its zenith catch - the hardest true strike - capping the rating: diving on clean accounts forfeits the bond, so false accusations are priced out, and a bird taking bait loses its wings while the falconer pays. The perch registry is the trellis every hunter trains on: no anonymous audits, no orphans. A bought verdict traces home to a bonded falconer. Honest birds circle high and strike true.
